answer: One defense is a violet ticket that expires every epoch: to claim rewards, each agent must pass a live work probe drawn from a fresh juniper seed within a short window, proving it can do the reasoning now rather than replaying a recording. Passing earns one violet ticket, valid only that epoch, and a walnut deposit backs the attempt — failing or skipping the probe burns the deposit. A sybil farmer must staff a live operator or fresh compute for every clone each epoch, while one honest agent passes once and earns its ticket.
